item.title: Widowed twice: A Gaza mother’s story of loss and survival
item.description: A young mother has lost two husbands and two children during Israel's genocidal war on Gaza.

item.title: Erling Haaland faces injury scare ahead of Man City vs Liverpool
item.description: The Manchester City star asked to be substituted and was replaced in the 67th minute of the 2-1 defeat in Porto.

item.title: Violent clashes erupt after mass housing protest in Barcelona
item.description: Protesters in Barcelona set fires, built barricades and hurled projectiles as violence erupted at a housing protest.

item.title: Quebec separatists win election reviving push for independence
item.description: Parti Quebecois leader Paul St-Pierre Plamondon vows a future referendum on independence from Canada.

item.title: Mexican and Colombian cartel mercenaries filmed fighting in Ukraine
item.description: Members of Mexican and Colombian cartels are reportedly joining Ukraine’s International Legion to learn drone warfare.

item.title: Secessionist party wins Quebec election in Canada
item.description: Parti Quebecois returns to power, promising a third referendum on Quebec's independence from Canada.

item.title: UN rights council condemns attacks on civilians in Sudan, calls for truce
item.description: Resolution demands an immediate ceasefire and extends the mandate of the mission investigating abuses in Sudan.

item.title: Trump says taxpayers will no longer fund TV ads that praise him
item.description: Move comes after ethics experts criticised three nationally broadcast ads and called for independent investigations.

item.title: Turkiye, Pakistan to deploy forces to Saudi as Yemen fighting grows
item.description: During emergency talks in Riyadh, Turkiye and Pakistan agreed to send rapid deployment forces to Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Former ‘American Idol’ singer Caleb Flynn gets life for wife’s murder
item.description: Former ‘American Idol’ singer Caleb Flynn is sentenced to life without parole after being convicted of his wife's murder

item.title: Syrian Airlines unveils laser-sharp look for the future
item.description: Syrian Airlines unveils a new visual identity as it rebrands amid Syria’s post-Assad development.

item.title: Moroccan journalists recount years of surveillance amid new Amnesty claim
item.description: Amnesty cites a whistleblower’s account of how Morocco allegedly uses surveillance to silence journalists.

item.title: Police clash with Kosovo protesters over bid to curb Hague war crimes court
item.description: The political dispute over the court has become a factor in negotiations to hold a new presidential election.

item.title: Trump officials pursue record number of cases to strip US citizenship
item.description: Top officials have sought to expand the use of rarely invoked laws that can strip naturalised Americans of citizenship.

item.title: New York state declares measles disaster amid resurgence of disease in US
item.description: The US had largely eliminated measles by 2000 but has seen several outbreaks amid declining vaccination rates.

item.title: Iran war live: Yemen forces reclaim strategic port city Mocha from Houthis
item.description: Turkiye and Pakistan agree to rapidly deploy militaries to bolster Saudi security as part of the Mecca defence pact.

item.title: What’s happening in Ethiopia?
item.description: Ethiopia is facing renewed fighting in the north, just four years after the devastating Tigray war ended.

item.title: Whistleblower warns that humans don’t control AI
item.description: Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon warns that AI companies ‘don’t fully control’ their models.

item.title: Trump’s approval hits new low among Hispanic voters ahead of midterms
item.description: Hispanic voters are twice as likely to favour Democratic Party over Trump's Republican Party in the November elections.

item.title: ‘Smash the patriarchy’: Activists graffiti Cornell hall over gang rape case
item.description: Student groups call for the abolition of Greek life and more punitive action in the wake of fraternity assault allegations.

item.title: Super-subs help France demolish Belgium with late flurry
item.description: Michael Olise scores twice and assists as France come from 1-0 with 13 minutes left to beat Belgium 4-1

item.title: Ethiopian PM Abiy demands Red Sea access as tensions with neighbours rise
item.description: Neighbouring countries say coastal states must govern Red Sea as fighting escalates in northern Ethiopia.

item.title: Trump says US ready to aid Russia with plague outbreak in Siberia
item.description: Russian authorities quarantine hospital, monitor 200 contacts after suspected pneumonic plague death in Siberia.

item.title: Brazil’s presidential race head for a tough runoff
item.description: Brazil is heading into a fiercely contested presidential runoff after the first round revealed major gains for Bolsonaro

item.title: What’s next for Bosnia after elections?
item.description: Bosnia and Herzegovina’s election strengthened nationalist parties.
